title: Homework Debate
text:
Many people argue that homework should be banned in primary schools. In their view, children need more time to play and rest after a long day. However, some teachers believe that small amounts of homework help students build good habits. The author, a former teacher, takes a middle position: homework should be short and meaningful.

The author supports this compromise with a clear example. In her view, ten minutes of reading each evening is more useful than an hour of worksheets. She admits that some families find it hard to fit reading into busy evenings. Still, she concludes that a modest daily routine is worth the effort.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do many people argue about homework in primary schools?
options: It should be given only on Fridays
It should be graded every day

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what does the author suggest is more useful than an hour of worksheets?
options: Ten minutes of reading each evening

questions.text: What can be inferred about the author's stance on homework?
options: She supports a moderate, short homework routine
She believes teachers should decide nothing
She is indifferent to the debate

questions.text: Why does the author mention busy evenings?
options: To acknowledge that a daily routine can be hard for some families
To show that families prefer worksheets
To argue that reading is unnecessary
To explain why teachers ban homework

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas argumentam que o dever de casa deveria ser proibido nos anos iniciais. Na opinião delas, as crianças precisam de mais tempo para brincar e descansar depois de um longo dia. No entanto, alguns professores acreditam que pequenas quantidades de dever de casa ajudam os alunos a criar bons hábitos. A autora, ex-professora, adota uma posição intermediária: o dever de casa deve ser curto e significativo.

A autora apoia esse meio-termo com um exemplo claro. Na opinião dela, dez minutos de leitura a cada noite são mais úteis do que uma hora de fichas de exercícios. Ela admite que algumas famílias acham difícil encaixar a leitura em noites cheias. Ainda assim, conclui que uma rotina diária modesta vale o esforço.
